Collections.Name: Open Peeps
Collections.Description: Hand-drawn mix-and-match people. Every figure carries named parts (head, hairstyle, face, facial hair, accessories, pose), so it can be recoloured and split into its individual pieces.

Collections.Name: Open Doodles
Collections.Description: Hand-drawn doodle scenes with a dark ink stroke and one accent colour. Recolourable through the palette, but the artwork is not split into named parts.

Collections.Name: Kitbitz Space
Collections.Description: Hand-drawn space-scene props (ships, planets, craters, bases) from the Kitbitz asset library. Individual pieces with inline hex colours; recolour-only, no named part groups.
Collections.SourceRevision: kitbitz kit assets, downloaded 2026-09-25 (139 of 170 SVGs; 31 Figma exports with embedded raster or foreignObject excluded)

Collections.Name: Kitbitz Food
Collections.Description: Hand-drawn food and drink props (fruit, bread, coffee, packaging) from the Kitbitz asset library. Individual pieces with inline hex colours; recolour-only, no named part groups.

Collections.Name: Kitbitz Winter
Collections.Description: Hand-drawn winter props (snow, trees, cabins, seasonal objects) from the Kitbitz asset library. Individual pieces with inline hex colours; recolour-only, no named part groups.
